items.forecaster_or_survey: 2022 Expert Survey on Progress in AI (AI Impacts)
items.question_wording_original: How likely is it that the long-run effect of advanced AI on humanity will be extremely bad (e.g., human extinction)?
items.horizon_note: 'Long-run effect' with no endpoint; treated as eventual.
items.conditions: Conditional on high-level machine intelligence existing (survey framing).
items.selection_effects: Self-selected respondents among invited authors; 48% gave at least 10%, 25% gave 0%.
items.framing_effects: Answers depended on whether respondents were asked about extinction directly or as one of several outcomes.
items.calibration: Not a forecasting-trained population; no scoring possible.
items.transformation_note: 'Extremely bad (e.g., human extinction)' mapped to the combined p(DOOM) set O3–O8 because respondents were not asked to separate extinction from other irreversible outcomes.
